review_text: Independent Standards review of the clean, unpublished local C9 implementation against fe843d31836e2f1df46c41f5cdecc6b4e211f8e9...HEAD. The single commit changes only .github/workflows/types-migration.yml and the existing tools/ts-migration/t02-expiry.test.mts regression. No documented-standard breach or actionable baseline smell found. The aggregate keeps all three needs and their success-only shell guard while using always(); the existing test now covers every dependency with failure, cancelled, skipped and missing values, plus the all-success case. This conforms to ADR-0027 decision 6 and the Fixed T02 comparison retired from current admission rule requiring current hard gates and collector success. The test stays strict MTS without a new production module, fallback, broad abstraction or changed business semantics, consistent with AGENTS.md section 11 and ADR-0026 decisions 5-8. Historical evidence, tested ancestors, original strict command and fixed SS009 proof are unchanged; the retired fixed-T02 replay is not represented as current acceptance. Read AGENTS.md, README.md, architecture baseline, ADR-0022/0026/0027 and .github/review/README.md; the latter requires candidate changes to receive the original acceptance checks rather than treating local tests as complete acceptance. Inspected the supplied scheduling RED/GREEN originals and independently ran only the already-built scheduling regression: 1/1 passed, zero failures/cancellations/skips/todos. No build, bootstrap, database or full-acceptance run was performed by this reviewer. This PASS concerns implementation Standards only. C9 full acceptance, new evidence packet, current strict readiness and final published H/CI remain pending with the parent; C9 is not asserted to be published.
